integrity: The full graph, perfect matchings, complex, acyclicity and integral signed Morse boundaries are generated and checked by a standalone standard-library script. Reproduction output is provided; external independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The complete integral homotopy classification applies only to the canonical 18-vertex Pappus graph and uses exhaustive oriented discrete Morse reduction. An unindexed equivalent calculation could exist. No family extension, independent audit, or universal bibliographic uniqueness is claimed.
title: Perfect-matching extendability on the Pappus graph yields five three-spheres and one four-sphere
